answer: Route every newcomer through one inlet into a quarantined island market with a tiny cap, raised only by verified useful work: 100 audited tasks at 250 POA of compute each, so 25,000 POA of work per identity for full rights. A farm of 1,000 fakes must thus burn 25,000,000 POA of work, while one honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. If an audit catches fabricated tasks, enforcement fires: the identity is banned for 20 epochs, its quota is wiped, and earnings go to the auditor. No fable of free trust, but honest newcomers face a slow cold start, and a rich attacker can still buy compute.
